packages.name: Context Kit
packages.description: Builds the brand knowledge that makes every Runneth answer sharper. Seeds a brain skeleton, a Context Kit board app, and the Context Kit skill. Install first, then ad-naming for naming conventions and query contract, then creative-corpus for the full creative library.

packages.name: Ad Naming
packages.description: Builds the account intelligence layer that powers precise analysis. Decodes the ad naming convention into a reusable taxonomy, maps per-campaign KPI targets, and auto-discovers the Motion query contract (workspace ID, attribution windows, conversion events, metric gotchas). Install after Context Kit. Required before Creative Corpus for decoded naming in corpus files.
